---
title: Updates
guide-section: Use it
---

## New releases

- Installed automatically by the scheduled check: within 15 minutes by day, an hour overnight.
- What changed: [Releases](https://github.com/joshwlivingston/ha-automations/releases), or **Changelog** in the menu.
- A release may rename or change settings. Check the changelog and update `apps.yaml`.

## Tasks

| Task | How |
|---|---|
| See which release runs | Latest **Deploy** run under **Actions**. The deploy step is named after the release, e.g. **Deploy v0.1.0**. |
| Install a specific release | Open **Actions > Deploy > Run workflow**, enter a **version** (e.g. `v0.1.0`), select **Run workflow** |
| Redeploy with no changes | **Run workflow** with **force** checked |
| Pause updates | **Actions > Deploy > ... > Disable workflow**. Pushes stop deploying too. |
| Resume updates | **Actions > Deploy > Enable workflow** |

## Roll back

1. Install the older release.
2. Disable the workflow. Otherwise the next scheduled check reinstalls the latest release.
3. Enable it once a fixed release is out.
